# stb_image

Public-domain decoder from [nothings/stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb) (`stb_image.h`).

Copied from **rigImage** (`packs/rigImage/third_party/stb/stb_image.h`), itself the ImGuizmo example copy (v2.16). File-dialog thumbnails decode here so **rigImGui** does not depend on the optional **rigImage** pack.
